name: Number With The Given Amount Of Divisors
description: Given the number n , find the smallest positive integer which has exactly n divisors. It is guaranteed that for the given n the answer will not exceed 10 18 .
input_specification: The first line of the input contains integer n ( 1 ≤ n ≤ 1000 ).
output_specification: Output the smallest positive integer with exactly n divisors.
approach_summary: Apply Knapsack and Basic Dynamic Programming paradigm under the Dynamic Programming (DP) framework. Exploit problem invariants to reduce state space and achieve optimal complexity.
